body.en:
The hex nut family is small in name and large in practice, because the shape is the same while the proportions and the class change with the application. The standard hex nut is the general-purpose part, sized to match a bolt of the same diameter and finished to the same class. The heavy hex nut is thicker and wider across the flats, used where the load is high enough that thread stripping, rather than bolt fracture, would be the failure mode — structural steelwork, tower bolting, heavy plant.

Three variants serve narrower purposes. Thin nuts are used as jam nuts or where space is limited, and they are not a substitute for a full nut in a loaded connection. Flange nuts carry an integral bearing surface, which spreads load on thin or soft material and removes the separate washer. Coupling nuts are long and threaded through, used to join two threaded rods or to act as a connector in tension.

Locking variants answer a different question. A nylon-insert nut resists vibration by friction on the thread, a distorted-thread nut does the same without the insert, and a nut with a mechanical key or a castellated nut with a pin resists loosening positively rather than by friction. The distinction matters because friction-based locking depends on the nut being used once: a nylon-insert nut that has been run on and off several times has lost the interference that made it work.

What buyers most often get wrong is matching nut to bolt by diameter alone. A nut of the right diameter and the wrong class is an assembly that fails at the nut, and a nut of the right class and the wrong thread tolerance is an assembly that will not seat. The pair is the component, and it should be bought and documented as one.

A fourth variant worth knowing is the weld nut, which carries a weldable projection and is fixed to a steel part before assembly. It is used where the joint will be made from one side only — automotive, appliance and light fabrication — and its quality depends on the welding rather than on the thread, so a weld nut that is correctly specified and badly welded is a joint that fails at the weld.

The family also divides by finish rather than by shape. Plain, plated, zinc flake, hot-dip galvanised and stainless versions of the same shape behave completely differently in service, and a buyer who specifies the shape without the finish has specified half the part.

None of these shapes is exotic; what is exotic is a specification that names the shape and leaves the class, the thread tolerance and the coating to the supplier.

The practical rule that follows is simple enough to put on a purchase order: every nut line should name the diameter, the class, the thread tolerance, the coating class and the marking, and every nut line should name the bolt it is meant to pair with.

Everything in this list can be checked with a caliper, a thread gauge, a specification and a pair of eyes.

body.en:
Specification of a hex nut is a short list in which every item is a decision. Diameter and thread pitch set the fit. The property class sets the strength, and it should match or exceed the class of the bolt it will be used with. The coating sets the service life and, in the case of hot-dip galvanising, the fit, because a thick coating on a nut requires either an oversize tap or a coated bolt to match.

Standard references do the work that a description cannot. A metric hex nut specification names the dimension series, the thread tolerance, the mechanical property class and the test methods, so a supplier who quotes to the reference is quoting a defined object. Where a project cites a standard without a class, the class is still required, because the standard says how the nut will be judged and not what it must carry.

Stainless nuts follow the same logic with a different language: the grade designation identifies the steel family, and the strength follows from the family plus cold working rather than from a class number. The practical pairing rule holds — a stainless nut on a stainless bolt, with a defined lubricant to prevent galling, because a seized stainless assembly on a structural bolt becomes a cutting job.

Marking completes the specification. A nut intended for a graded connection carries its class and its maker's mark, and a carton that mixes classes is a carton that has been re-packed. The check at goods-in is a minute per batch, and it is the only check that travels with the goods.

One tolerance point that causes real problems is the relationship between coating thickness and thread fit. Hot-dip galvanising adds thickness to both the inside and the outside of a nut, and a nut that is tapped to the standard before galvanising may not run onto a galvanised bolt afterwards. The practical answers are to specify a nut tapped oversize for the coating, to specify a zinc flake coating that does not disturb the fit, or to buy the bolt and nut as a matched galvanised pair from the same source.

Sampling and testing are proportionate to the part. A dimensional check of the thread with a gauge, a hardness check for a graded nut, and a proof load test on a sample from each batch will confirm more than any document, and they can be done with equipment that a distributor already has. The certificate then becomes the record of what was done rather than a promise about it.

A nut that arrives with no marking beside a graded bolt is the most common non-conformity in this category, and it is the one that a photograph of the carton label settles in a minute.

Where a project requires third-party inspection, agree before production which batches will be sampled and which tests will be witnessed, because an inspection request raised after the goods are packed becomes a re-packing cost rather than a test.

body.ar: تتراوح أحجام الصواميل السداسية من M3 إلى M64 وفق النظام المتري أو من #4 إلى 2-1/2 بوصة وفق النظام الإمبراطوري، مما يوفر مرونة كبيرة في اختيار المقاس المناسب لكل تطبيق. تتوفر الصواميل بدرجات مختلفة تشمل الدرجة 2 من الفولاذ الكربوني المنخفض للتطبيقات الخفيفة، والدرجة 5 من الفولاذ الكربوني المتوسط للبناء العام، والدرجة 8 من سبيكة الفولاذ الكربوني المتوسط للتطبيقات عالية الشد، والدرجة 10 من السبيكة للتطبيقات الإنشائية الحرجة. تُصنع الصواميل من مواد متنوعة تشمل الفولاذ الكربوني والفولاذ السبائكي والفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ بأنواعه 304 و316 و316L، مما يوفر خيارات متعددة حسب متطلبات القوة ومقاومة التآكل. تشمل الطلاءات المتاحة الصنف البسيط والمطلية بالزنك والمجلفنة بالغمس الساخن وطلاء Dacromet وطلاء PTFE، والتي توفر مستويات مختلفة من الحماية من التآكل حسب بيئة التطبيق. تستوفي صواميل TradeGo السداسية أو تتجاوز معايير DIN 934 / ISO 4032 و ANSI B18.2.2. يتطلب sourcing القائم على المعايير التعلم المستمر حيث يتم تحديث معايير ISO وASTM وDIN وGB كل 3-5 سنوات. يُنصح بالاشتراك في إشعارات تحديثات المعايير ومراجعة المواصفات سنوياً لضمان الامتثال. تشمل أكثر المعايير شيوعاً المستخدمة في تجارة أدوات التثبيت الدولية ISO 898-1 للخصائص الميكانيكية وISO 3506-1 للفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ وISO 3269 لفحص القبول وISO 4042 للطلاءات وISO 1502 لمقاييس الخيوط. بالنسبة لمشتري B2B، يُعد بناء مكتبة مرجعية للمعايير تحتوي على 20 معياراً على الأقل ذات الصلة بمزيج منتجاتهم أمراً ضرورياً. تُعتبر إدارة المخزون جانباً حاسماً في sourcing أدوات التثبيت، حيث يجب موازنة تكاليف التخزين مع مخاطر نفاد المخزون. تستخدم العديد من الشركات المصنعة الصينية أنظمة إدارة المخزون المتقدمة لضمان توفر المنتجات مع تقليل التكاليف.

body.pt: As especificações padrão para porcas sextavadas abrangem uma ampla gama de dimensões e classificações para atender diferentes requisitos de engenharia: Faixa de Tamanhos: M3 a M64 (métrico) ou #4 a 2-1/2" (imperial), cobrindo praticamente todas as aplicações industriais conhecidas. Classificações (Grades): Grade 2 (baixo carbono): Para aplicações de serviço leve, onde não são exigidas altas propriedades mecânicas, como em móveis e equipamentos domésticos. Grade 5 (médio carbono): Para construção geral e aplicações estruturais médias, sendo a classificação mais utilizada em aplicações comerciais e industriais padrão. Grade 8 (liga de médio carbono): Para aplicações de alta resistência, onde são requeridas propriedades mecânicas superiores, como em componentes automotivos críticos e equipamentos de construção. Grade 10 (liga): Para aplicações estruturais críticas, onde a falha do componente pode resultar em riscos significativos, como em pontes, edifícios altos e equipamentos de mineração. Materiais: Aço carbono, aço ligado, aço inoxidável (304, 316, 316L), cada um oferecendo diferentes propriedades de resistência à corrosão e força mecânica para atender condições ambientais específicas. Revestimentos: Plain (sem revestimento), zincado (eletrozincado), galvanizado a quente, dacromet e PTFE, proporcionando diferentes níveis de proteção contra corrosão dependendo das condições de exposição ambiental. As porcas sextavadas TradeGo atendem ou excedem os padrões DIN 934/ISO 4032 e ANSI B18.2.2, garantindo compatibilidade internacional e desempenho confiável. A compras baseadas em padrões requerem aprendizado contínuo, pois as normas ISO, ASTM, DIN e GB são revisadas a cada 3-5 anos. É essencial assinar notificações de atualizações de padrões e revisar especificações anualmente para manter conformidade. Os padrões mais comuns usados no comércio internacional de fixadores são ISO 898-1 (propriedades mecânicas), ISO 3506-1 (inoxidável), ISO 3269 (inspeção de aceitação), ISO 4042 (revestimentos) e ISO 1502 (calibres de rosca). Para compradores B2B, construir uma biblioteca de referência de padrões com pelo menos os 20 principais padrões relevantes para sua linha de produtos é essencial para garantir qualidade consistente e conformidade regulatória.

body.en:
Wholesale pricing for hex nuts is a structure, not a published number: no fixed figure printed on a page survives a change in the wire price, the zinc price or the energy cost, and a page that presents one is presenting a snapshot as if it were a price. What a buyer can work with is the composition, because each element can be discussed separately.

The base is material and forming: the mass of the nut at the specified diameter and class, plus cold or hot forming, tapping and, where the class requires it, heat treatment. A heavy hex nut carries more mass than a standard one at the same diameter, and that difference is in the price before any coating is considered. The second element is the coating: plating to a stated thickness, mechanical zinc, zinc flake to a coating class, or hot-dip galvanising, each with its own cost and its own implication for the tap size.

The third element is packing and presentation: bulk cartons, printed cartons, small boxes, palletisation and labelling. On nuts this element is larger than buyers expect, because the parts are heavy relative to their value and the packing is a real share of the landed cost. The fourth is the document package and the freight, which move the price from ex-works to delivered, and the fifth is volume and payment terms.

The commercial lever with the most effect is consolidation. Nuts are bought in sets with bolts, and a supplier who can pack matched sets and ship them as one line removes handling and documentation from both sides. A buyer who consolidates diameters, classes and coatings into a small number of order lines usually does better than one who negotiates a unit price on a fragmented order.

Minimum order quantities on nuts follow the same logic as on bolts, and they are usually set by the coating batch rather than by the forming run. A plating barrel or a galvanising batch has a working minimum, and a supplier who explains that minimum is telling the buyer where the real constraint sits. Consolidating diameters or combining with bolts in the same order is usually the way to meet it without paying a penalty.

The comparison that matters is landed cost for a defined specification, with the packing and the document package included on both sides. A price quoted for a bulk carton and a price quoted for a printed retail box are not the same offer, and the difference is often larger than the difference in the nut.

Finally, ask what the supplier will not change. A supplier who can hold one thread tolerance, one coating class and one marking standard across repeat orders is worth more than one who can match any price once.

A buyer who keeps the quotation, the certificate and the carton label for each batch is running a small quality system, and it is the only one that most distributors can afford.

That record is also what makes the next order cheaper to place: the specification is already written, the sample already approved, and the price discussion has nothing left to hide behind.

A supplier who will state, in writing, which lines are held in stock and which are made to order is giving the buyer the only schedule information that matters at quotation stage.

a.zh: 先按用途把螺母类型定到标准：标准六角螺母对应 DIN 934/ISO 4032，法兰螺母 DIN 6923，尼龙嵌件锁紧螺母 DIN 985，冠形螺母配开口销使用。规格覆盖 M3 至 M36，常见 6、8、10、12 级，配 10.9 螺栓的 10 级螺母通常要经过热处理；材料分碳钢、合金钢以及 304、316 不锈钢。核验时看头部等级标记与材质书炉号能否对上，镀层和螺纹精度按订单验收，批量一致性靠逐批追溯文件保证，必要时可安排第三方验货机构到场抽检。

a.ru: В серии ходят стандартные, тонкие, усиленные, фланцевые, гайки с нейлоновой вставкой и приварные. Каждый тип привязан к своему стандарту — ISO 4032, DIN 934, DIN 985 для нейлонового стопора, — поэтому в заказе называют стандарт и класс, а не просто «гайка».
a.ar: الصواميل القياسية والرفيعة والثقيلة، وصواميل الفلنجة، وصواميل القفل بحشوة نايلون، وصواميل اللحام، كلها إنتاج روتيني. وكل نوع يقابل معياراً مختلفاً: ISO 4032 وDIN 934 وDIN 985 لقفل النايلون، لذا اذكر المعيار ودرجة القوة لا مجرد صامولة سداسية. ويساعد تحديد الشكل والوجه والطلاء في الوصول إلى عرض موحد يقبل المقارنة بين الموردين.
a.es: La estándar, la delgada, la pesada, la de brida, la autoblocante de nailon y la de soldadura son todas rutinarias. Cada una corresponde a una norma distinta: ISO 4032, DIN 934, DIN 985 para la autoblocante de nailon, así que nombre la norma y el grado, no solo 'tuerca hexagonal'. El tipo se elige según la unión y la carga que debe soportar.
a.fr: Standard, fin, lourd, à bride, frein à insert nylon et écrous à souder sont tous courants. Chacun correspond à une norme différente — ISO 4032, DIN 934, DIN 985 pour le frein nylon — donc nommez la norme et le grade, pas seulement « écrou hexagonal ». Le modèle suit la fonction du joint et la place disponible. Un écrou mal désigné complète mal le boulon associé. La référence normatif évite l'ambiguïté sur le produit.
a.pt: Padrão, fina, pesada, flange, trava com insert de nylon e porca de solda são todos rotineiros. Cada uma mapeia uma norma diferente: ISO 4032, DIN 934, DIN 985 para trava de nylon. Nomeia-se a norma e a classe, não apenas 'porca sextavada'. O tipo é escolhido pela função da junta, e a norma declarada no pedido deve bater com a porca entregue.
a.de: Standard, dünn, schwer, Flansch, Nylon-Sicherungs- und Schweißmuttern sind alle Routine. Jede gehört zu einer anderen Norm – ISO 4032, DIN 934, DIN 985 für die Nylonsicherung – also nennen Sie Norm und Klasse, nicht nur «Sechskantmutter». Der Typ folgt der Funktion des Gelenks und dem verfügbaren Raum. Eine ungenau bezeichnete Mutter passt nicht zum zugehörigen Bolzen. Die Normangabe vermeidet Unklarheit über das Produkt.
a.ja: 線材または棒鋼を切断し、鍛造で六角の形状を作り、ねじを立て、熱処理と被覆を施します。製造元によってはねじ立てと熱処理を内製で行い、一部は外部工程に委ねます。工程の内製と委託を確認し、品質記録の責任範囲を整えてください。現場の条件を記録し、同じ仕様を繰り返し使うことで、供給と管理を安定させられます。

a.en: M3 to M36 in classes 6, 8, 10 and 12 is standard range, with M8 to M20 the highest-volume sizes for African construction orders. Class 10 nuts for 10.9 bolts often need heat treatment and are priced accordingly.
a.zh: M3–M36、6/8/10/12 级是常规范围，非洲建筑订单量最大的是 M8–M20。配 10.9 螺栓的 10 级螺母通常要热处理，价格也相应更高。
a.hi: मानक श्रेणी M3 से M36 तक वर्ग 6, 8, 10 और 12 में आती है; अफ्रीकी निर्माण ऑर्डर में M8 से M20 तक के साइज़ सबसे ज्यादा चलते हैं। 10.9 बोल्ट के लिए वर्ग 10 नट अक्सर हीट ट्रीटमेंट मांगते हैं, और उनकी दर उसी हिसाब से तय होती है।
a.ru: Стандартный диапазон M3…M36, классы 6, 8, 10 и 12; наибольший объём у заказов в Африке приходится на размеры M8…M20. Гайки класса 10 под болты 10.9 часто проходят термообработку, и это закладывается в изготовление; цена формируется под класс и технологию.
a.ar: المدى القياسي هو M3 إلى M36 بفئات 6 و8 و10 و12، وتعد M8 إلى M20 أكثر المقاسات حجماً في طلبات البناء الأفريقية. وكثيراً ما تحتاج صواميل الفئة 10 المخصصة لبراغي 10.9 إلى معالجة حرارية، ويُسعَّر بناءً على ذلك. وتُسحب الفئة والدرجة معاً في أمر الشراء، لأن صامولة بدرجة أدنى تحد من قوة الوصلة كلها حتى مع براغي عالية القوة.
a.es: De M3 a M36 en las clases 6, 8, 10 y 12 es la gama estándar, con M8 a M20 los tamaños de mayor volumen para pedidos de construcción africanos. Las tuercas clase 10 para pernos 10.9 a menudo necesitan tratamiento térmico y se valoran en consecuencia. La gama cubre desde fijación ligera hasta unión de alta resistencia.
a.fr: De M3 à M36 en classes 6, 8, 10 et 12 est la plage standard, avec M8 à M20 comme tailles les plus vendues pour les commandes de construction africaines. Les écrous classe 10 pour boulons 10.9 demandent souvent un traitement thermique. La taille suit le boulon et le diamètre du joint. Les gammes hors série peuvent exiger un outillage particulier. Vérifiez la classe avant d'associer l'écrou au boulon.
a.pt: M3 a M36 nas classes 6, 8, 10 e 12 é a faixa padrão, com M8 a M20 os tamanhos de maior volume em pedidos de construção africanos. Porcas classe 10 para parafusos 10.9 frequentemente precisam de tratamento térmico e têm preço correspondente. A classe da porca deve casar com a do parafuso, e o tratamento é registrado no certificado do lote.
a.de: M3 bis M36 in den Klassen 6, 8, 10 und 12 ist der Standardbereich, mit M8 bis M20 als umlaufstärksten Größen für afrikanische Bauaufträge. Muttern Klasse 10 für 10.9-Bolzen brauchen oft eine Wärmebehandlung. Die Größe folgt dem Bolzen und dem Durchmesser des Gelenks. Die Sondermaße können ein besonderes Werkzeug verlangen. Prüfen Sie die Klasse vor dem Zusammenstellen von Mutter und Bolzen.
a.ja: ねじの寸法と山形状、ねじ規格と適合ゲージ、焼き入れと硬度、被覆厚さ、外観と包装の検査です。高強度ナットには機械試験と材料証明を求めてください。抜取り基準と記録を定め、ロットごとに確認します。環境と相手材を確認し、記録を残して手順を守ることで、後の不具合を減らせます。

a.hi: वायर रॉड की लागत, टैपिंग की गति और टूल की उम्र, कोटिंग का प्रकार, तथा नट के दोनों फेस पर चैम्फर है या नहीं — ये दरें चलाते हैं। सस्ती चीज़ों पर पैकिंग और कंटेनर लोडिंग भी मायने रखती है, क्योंकि ऐसी वस्तु में भाड़ा लैंडेड लागत का बड़ा हिस्सा होता है।
a.ru: Стоимость формируют проволочная заготовка, скорость нарезки резьбы и ресурс инструмента, тип покрытия, а также наличие фасок с двух граней. Упаковка и загрузка в контейнер важны для недорогих позиций, где фрахт составляет большую долю стоимости доставки; ставки зависят от объёма партии и спецификации.
a.ar: سلك الفولاذ الخام، وسرعة تقطيع الخيوط وعمر الأدوات، ونوع الطلاء، وهل الصامولة مشطوفة الوجهين. ويهم التعبئة وطريقة تحميل الحاويات في الأصناف الرخيصة حيث يشكل النقل حصة كبيرة من التكلفة النهائية. ويعتمد السعر النهائي على الكمية والمقاس والدرجة والطلاء، ويُفصح عن هيكل التسعير في العرض بدلاً من رقم ثابت في القائمة.
a.es: El costo de alambrón, la velocidad de roscado y la vida útil de la herramienta, el tipo de recubrimiento y si las tuercas llevan bisel en ambas caras. El empaque y la carga del contenedor pesan en artículos baratos donde el flete representa una parte grande del costo puesto en destino. El precio se compone de esos elementos, no de una cifra fija en una página.
a.fr: Le coût du fil machine, la vitesse de taraudage et la vie de l'outil, le type de revêtement, et si les écrous sont chanfreinés sur les deux faces. L'emballage et le chargement du conteneur comptent sur les articles bon marché où le fret occupe une large part du coût livré. Une cotation se lit comme une structure de postes, non comme un chiffre figé. Comparez à spécification et Incoterm identiques.
a.pt: Custo do arame, velocidade de rosqueamento e vida de ferramenta, tipo de revestimento e se as porcas são chanfradas nas duas faces. Em itens baratos, embalagem e carregamento de contêiner pesam, pois o frete é parcela grande do custo landed. A cotação compara material, revestimento e condição comercial, não apenas o número unitário da porca.
a.de: Der Drahtstabkosten, die Gewindeschneidgeschwindigkeit und Werkzeuglebensdauer, der Beschichtungstyp und ob die Muttern beidseitig angefast sind. Verpackung und Containerladung spielen bei billigen Artikeln eine Rolle, wo das Fracht einen großen Anteil des eingetroffenen Preises ausmacht. Eine Angebotskurve liest sich als Struktur von Posten, nicht als feste Zahl. Vergleichen Sie bei gleicher Spezifikation und gleichem Incoterm.
a.ja: 標準品は在庫または短い生産枠で供給できます。特別な被覆、高強度ロット、非標準形状では生産と処理に数週間を見込んでください。注文に先立ち工程の余裕を確認し、必要書類の手配期間も含めて日程を組みます。書類と現物を照合し、納品までの工程を整えておくと、現場の手間を抑えられます。
